material_deltas: Couscous set to 1 1/2 cups dry plus 1 1/2 cups boiling water and 1/2 tsp kosher salt. v1 said for serving.
Allergens set to wheat because of the couscous. Dietary tags stay plant and dairy-free. Gluten-free is not claimed.
Chickpeas specified as 2 (15 oz) cans, drained and rinsed. Count not increased.
Skillet water set to 1/4 cup. v1 said a splash.
Preserved lemon specified as rinsed rind with the pulp discarded, still 2 tbsp chopped.
Spinach specified as 3 cups packed baby spinach (about 3 oz). Amount not increased.
Salt is only in the couscous. The skillet is salted by the preserved lemon.
Clock set to prep 10, cook 15, total 25 from the written steps. v1 15/25/40 was the default.
Did not turn it into a curry and did not add fresh lemon wedges.

dish.title: Moroccan Chickpea Skillet
dish.name: Moroccan Chickpea Skillet
dish.description: Chickpeas with ras el hanout, garlic, preserved lemon, and spinach over couscous, salted with the lemon and checked before serving.

provenance.note: Corrective draft against legacy v1. Authorship of the legacy text is not known.

recipe_version.immutability_note: Draft for audit. v1.json was not edited. Not kitchen-tested and not published.
recipe_version.title: Moroccan Chickpea Skillet
recipe_version.description: Chickpeas with ras el hanout, garlic, preserved lemon, and spinach over couscous, salted with the lemon and checked before serving.
recipe_version.doneness: Chickpeas glossy, spinach just wilted, couscous fluffy.

substitutions.couscous: This version uses wheat couscous. A gluten-free stand-in would change the allergen list and is not this version.
substitutions.preserved lemon: Rind only. Do not chop in the salty pulp, and do not swap in fresh lemon wedges.

ingredients.name: chickpeas
ingredients.note: 15 oz cans, drained and rinsed, about 3 cups.

ingredients.name: preserved lemon
ingredients.note: Chopped rind only. Rinse and discard the pulp.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: Divided: 1.5 cups boiling for the couscous, 0.25 cup in the skillet.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Divided: 2 g in the couscous water (about 0.5% of 1.5 cups, absorbed), and up to 2 g in the skillet after tasting. 4 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (1.5 tsp). The same weight is 0.75 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 0.75 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Steam the couscous
steps.body: Put the couscous and 2 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt in a bowl. Pour over 1.5 cups boiling water. Cover 5 minutes, then fluff. The 2 g in 1.5 cups is about 0.5% and the water is absorbed.

steps.title: Spice the chickpeas
steps.body: Warm the neutral oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the garlic and the ras el hanout and cook 1 minute. Add the chickpeas and 1/4 cup water. Cook 5 minutes, until the chickpeas are glossy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Stir in the preserved lemon and the spinach. Cook 1 to 2 minutes, until the spinach wilts. Taste a chickpea. Preserved lemon is already salty and brands vary, so add up to the remaining 2 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt only if the skillet tastes flat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the skillet over the couscous and top with the parsley.

projection.vocabulary_note: Dropped v1 tag curries. This is a skillet with a splash of water, not a curry. Kept citrusy because preserved lemon is in the dish.
projection.allergen_note: Wheat comes from the couscous. It is an allergen, not a dietary tag. Dietary eligibility stays plant and dairy-free. Gluten-free is not claimed.

culinary_revision.expected_flavor: Ras el hanout and garlic bloomed in oil, preserved lemon as the main salt, spinach wilted in, parsley on top. The old ban on any more salt is gone because lemon brands are not equally salty.
culinary_revision.dietary: Wheat unchanged. Plant and dairy-free. Parsley and garlic add no allergen.
culinary_revision.shopping: Garlic, parsley, and weighed salt join the existing cans, lemon, spice, spinach, and couscous.
culinary_revision.uncertainties: Preserved-lemon salt is the main unknown. The taste step exists for that reason.
culinary_revision.image_impact: 2026-10-18 hero is in public/images/meals. Independent audit of the exported WebP: PASS. Parsley on chickpeas, couscous underneath, preserved lemon as slivers. See docs/catalog/s08/IMAGE-PROVENANCE.md.
